modelDescription: The Savage Mark II  Bolt-Action Rimfire Rifle is an ideal rifle for small-game hunting, informal target shooting, and plinking. Savage's AccuTrigger enables shooters to obtain exceptional accuracy with the Savage Mark II F by allowing you to easily adjust it to your desired weight of pull for a light, crisp release with no creep.
